reviews.title: Feature Request: Separate Video Volume Control
reviews.text:
Please consider adding an option to control TikTok’s video volume separately from other audio playing on the device.

For example, I may be listening to rain sounds, music, a podcast, or another background audio app while scrolling TikTok. I would love to be able to mute TikTok videos completely while keeping my other audio playing.

A simple “Mute TikTok Videos” setting or an in-app volume slider would make this much easier. It would also be helpful to have the setting remembered until the user chooses to turn TikTok audio back on.

This would make TikTok much more comfortable to use for people who enjoy background sounds or music while scrolling. 🌧️
